Okay, so I need to figure out where the telefilm based on the 1977 Katherine Paterson book, Bridge to Terabithia, was shot. From the conversation, I see that there was a lot of back and forth between different agents trying to find the correct location. 

First, the Planner asked WebSurfer to look up the filming locations. WebSurfer found some low-quality sources saying it was filmed in New Zealand, but that didn't seem right. Then, WebSurfer tried looking on IMDb and Wikipedia, but there were timeouts and conflicting information. 

On IMDb, it initially showed Auckland, New Zealand, but later, when checking again, it listed Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. The Wikipedia page also confirmed Edmonton as the filming location. So, the mistake was probably when WebSurfer first found the New Zealand info without verifying it properly. 

I think the error happened when WebSurfer first provided the New Zealand info without cross-checking with more authoritative sources like IMDb and Wikipedia. That's why the Planner had to go back and verify the correct location step by step.
</think>

Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer initially provided conflicting information by reporting that the telefilm was filmed in New Zealand based on low-quality sources, without verifying against authoritative sources like IMDb and Wikipedia. This led to the Planner having to re-evaluate the correct filming location.
